name: Swisscom
notes: The main Swisscom Login supports passkeys as a passwordless sign-in (My Swisscom > Profile > Login & Security). Swisscom's help positions the passkey itself as two-factor (device key + biometric/PIN) rather than offering it as a separate second factor, so passkey_mfa stays false. Not to be confused with Swisscom Trust Services (e-signature), which has its own separate login and passkey docs. Submitted via community issue #13.
